On Thu, Jan 26, 2023 at 6:44 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Brian and Molly,
I hope you are both doing great!
As you know, USAID has been actively involved in the Summit for Democracy and we have used this past
"Year of Action" between Summits to expand our efforts to advance digital democracy and strengthen
information resilience in countries where we operate.
We have a number of updates to share with you and your colleagues!
Would it be possible to get a meeting on the calendar to chat with you and your team about our respective
priorities in this space and opportunities for collaboration? In particular, we would like to discuss the following:
Launch of the Agency's Advancing Digital Democracy initiative in 2023 and opportunities for partnership;
Agency's role in donor coordination under the FOC;
Meta's plans to engage in the March 2023 Summit for Democracy;
Efforts to strengthen information resilience; and
A 30-40 minute consultation on USAID's forthcoming Digital Democracy Principles through which we wil
articulate the Agency's affirmative vision for digital democracy and strengthen our do-no-harm approact
digital work. We believe private sector perspectives are critical for getting this right! We don't
anticipate that everyone joining the broader conversation would need to stay on for this more narrow
discussion, though we would appreciate it if folks working
on human rights and democracy are able to join
Are you available to meet the week of January 30th or the following for an hour? Many thanks in advance for
your time and we look forward to connecting with you.
Thanks very much,
Vera
